_doc: Hard tool limits for every team agent and hire (docs/switch/13-agent-lockdown.md). Merged into each managed agent's definition by scripts/switch-up.sh, scripts/switch-sync-agents.sh and server/src/switch.ts createManagedAgent. tools: Claude Code tool allowlist (names only; Switch always keeps mcp__switch). maxTurns: Claude Code agent field (Console advanced config 'Max turns'), a cap on model round-trips per run; the live War Room run peaked at 10 per prompt, so 40 never cuts a normal reply but stops a runaway loop. auto_mode false = claude --permission-mode default: anything .claude/settings.json does not allow waits for a human's approval in Switch.
